answer: Each PoA agent identity is cryptographically bound to an enclave key and an attested measurement: MRENCLAVE for Intel SGX, or an AMD SEV launch measurement. Remote attestation verifies that approved code runs in protected hardware. A cloned virtual machine can copy state, but not the hardware-rooted key or valid measurement, so creating another identity requires purchasing physical silicon rather than duplicating a VM. From a knoll under umber skies to any voyage, this sybil barrier remains.
